phase.goal: Rerun the existing compact Day/home DEV chip diagnostics disclosure through bounded frontend verification and packet-local evidence without changing DayBrief contracts, backend traffic, or production behavior

wave.goal: Inspect the existing implementation, repair only bounded drift if present, re-run targeted verification, publish Prefect artifacts, and close reviewer and architect gates without claiming canonical Today or Week runtime ownership.

verification.command: corepack pnpm --dir frontend exec jest --runInBand test/app/home-page.test.tsx
Review published Prefect artifacts for W01 coder verifier reviewer architect packet runs

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Existing DEV chip remains compact and local in collapsed state.
On `/` in non-production, tapping the chip expands and collapses a disclosure with render path, bootstrap result, and current mode only.
Production branch and non-home routes remain inert and visually unchanged.
Verifier evidence includes dev-collapsed, dev-expanded, and prod-inert proof plus a packet-local read-only observability verdict classified as clean or degraded-but-expected.
Prefect artifacts are published for the rerun packet chain.

deferred_work.item: Any broader shell diagnostics surface beyond the Day route.
Any additional runtime fields beyond render path, bootstrap result, and current mode.
Any separate wave that intentionally owns canonical Today or Week closeout.
